description:
The world is full of little wonders. WorldNiche helps you find them.

Turn the globe, tap a country, or let curiosity choose your next stop. Explore 195 countries through the small details that make a place its own: a story from its past, an object in a museum, a song on the charts.

ONE CAPITAL A DAY
Guess the country from a capital clue. Any answer keeps your streak going. Sign in to compare weekly scores with friends, and turn on an evening reminder if you want a nudge.

A PLACE IN HISTORY
Start with a short country history and a dated UN population estimate or projection. Then discover a historical fact, follow its source, or come back for another story. Country readings are available offline.

A SONG TO BRING HOME
See what Apple Music listeners are playing in supported countries, and open a song in Apple Music. Where an Apple Music chart is unavailable, explore local radio airplay from Tuneping when station data is available.

KEEP A LITTLE OF EVERYWHERE
Save countries to your Journal and add private notes. With an account, your saved places, notes and exploration history sync across your devices. Guest journals stay on your device.

CURIOSITY IS BETTER TOGETHER
Create a profile with Sign in with Apple, share an invitation link, and see which countries your friends have explored. Choose whether to share your own explorations. Your notes and bookmarks stay private.

KEEP ASKING
Ask Niche follow-up questions on devices that support Apple Intelligence. Availability depends on your device, language and Apple Intelligence settings.

Built for iPhone, with native controls, larger text support, and layouts that adapt when you unfold iPhone Duo. Explore without creating an account. An internet connection is needed for fact updates, music charts and account features.

A country contains many cultures. These discoveries are invitations to ask, never assumptions about a person.
promotionalText: Which country calls Vienna its capital? Play a new clue each day, watch the globe turn to the answer, and compare weekly scores with friends.
whatsNew:
Play the daily capitals quiz on Discover. Guess once a day, turn the globe to the answer, and explore the country. Keep a streak on your device or sign in to compare weekly scores with friends. You can turn on an evening reminder in Settings.

Discover now fits the globe and controls on smaller screens and in landscape. Country pages show which friends have explored the country just below its music chart.
